# Anoop Sinkaran
Blacktown NSW, Australia • 0406 295 160 • ns.anoop@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

## Professional Summary
Accomplished Senior Quality Engineer and QA Lead with over 19 years of experience driving end-to-end test automation strategies, quality governance, and engineering transformation across healthcare and enterprise sectors. Expert in architecting modern automation frameworks using Playwright, Selenium, C#, and Kotlin while leveraging Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines and cutting-edge AI-assisted testing tools to accelerate release confidence. Proven technical leader adept at championing shift-left quality practices, mentoring cross-functional teams, and guiding complex platform migrations in regulated healthcare environments including Avant Mutual and SmartClinics.

## Core Competencies & Technical Skills
- **Quality Engineering & Leadership:** QA Team Leadership, Shift-Left Testing, Quality Governance, Defect Triage & Prioritization, Cross-Functional Release Management, Dual BA/QA Requirements Ownership
- **Automation Frameworks:** Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Android Espresso, iOS XCUITest, Robolectric
- **Languages & Technologies:** C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, Kotlin, Python, Java, SQL, .NET, React, UNIX Shell Scripting
- **CI/CD, DevOps & Observability:** Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, GitHub, Dynatrace, Mobile Security Framework (MobSF)
- **AI-Assisted Testing:** Custom Copilot SKILL Creation, Copilot CLI, Generative AI Prompting, Automated PR Review Workflows
- **Domain & Methodologies:** Healthcare & Medical Domain Systems, Payment Systems & API Gateways, Agile/Scrum, JIRA, Zephyr, TestRail, HP ALM

## Professional Experience

- Pioneered AI-assisted testing workflows by designing custom GitHub Copilot SKILLs and pairing AI tools with the Robolectric framework to unit test Coroutines and ViewModels, expanding test coverage across core payment components.
- Engineered Azure DevOps pipelines to automate API Gateway regression suites while integrating Mobile Security Framework (MobSF) for automated static code and vulnerability analysis across Android builds.
- Formulated comprehensive test strategies, documentation, and pilot programs to validate card payment message structures and failure modes prior to mass-market rollout.
- Functioned in a dual Business Analyst and Quality Engineer capacity to define user stories and design specifications for an enterprise terminal onboarding and licensing gateway.
- Speared design feedback and testing execution for an unattended EV charging payment project, ensuring high reliability across integration touchpoints.
